edits.new: The legacy reads of `recovery.v_ace_payment` and `recovery.v_ace_account` are not repeated here. Under DP-05 the payment is read through its owner's contract and the plan facts live in this service's own schema, so this story opens no other schema and no `v_ace_*` view. The `broken_plan` value is a reason of the route decision (rule R-RES-30), not a field or entity, so it needs no entry in LDM v9 or Data Classification v5. This story creates no `payment_match_rule` table; any match rule row stays in the PAYMENT_MATCH rule package (GAP-3179).

disposition.note: broken_plan is a route-decision reason value (R-RES-30), not a field or entity; no LDM or Data Classification entry needed. Note added to section 11.
